name: Nandīśvara (as named in the Yoga-bhāṣya on 4.3)
summary: Named in the bhāṣya on YS 4.3 as one of those to be cited as an example of dharma removing the obstruction of adharma; nothing more is stated in the passage. Not to be confused with the Nandīśvara of the Prābhākara tradition.
